purpose: Track C, step C1: a second Assembly101 recording of the same toy as recording 1 by a different subject, with a contiguous ~60 s span whose coarse actions cover attach interior + screw chassis + attach body (the same four parts: chassis, interior, body/rear_body, cabin).
toy_id_source: fine-grained-annotations CSV column toy_id for recording 1 (all rows c02a); the recording name carries it as `..._9033-c02a_9033_...`
candidates_considered: every assembly_* recording of toy c02a in annotations/coarse-annotations/coarse_seq_views.txt (4 recordings; 8 sequences counting disassembly)

chosen.label: nusar_9061
why: Different subject (9061 vs 9033) on the same toy c02a; all 8 static views and all 4 ego views exist on the Hub at the pinned revision, and the ego camera ids (HMC_21110305/21176623/21176875/21179183) are the same physical cameras as recording 1, so the Track 6 e3/e4 choice transfers by camera id.

The core span reproduces recording 1's coarse chain attach interior -> screw chassis -> attach body -> screw chassis (388.1-415.2 s) and additionally contains a second interior detach/attach cycle and the cabin attach, so all four parts are handled inside the window.

Differences from recording 1 that make it a real generalization test and must be named: the subject is much faster (the chain takes 27 s, not 60 s); a fifth part, the bumper, is handled and attached inside the window (recording 1 attached it at 813 s); the roof was attached at 312-330 s before the window, so the cabin/roof appearance may differ from recording 1's window.
chosen.frame_0_note: Proxy frame 0 = 374.000 s falls inside `unscrew chassis` (interior still in the chassis); the interior is detached at 375.7-376.5 s and all four parts are separate on the table from ~376.5 s (proxy frame ~75) until `attach interior` at 388.1 s (proxy frame 423). Seed-transfer workers should pick the seed frame from the contact sheet rather than assume frame 0.

rejected.reason: same subject (9033) as recording 1; rejected by the different-subject requirement. Also uses a different ego headset (HMC_8434xxxx/8435xxxx ids).

different subject, but no contiguous ~60 s span with attach interior + screw chassis + attach body: `attach interior` ends at 139.7 s and `attach body`/`screw chassis` run 191.4-214.7 s (51.7 s apart, with cabin work in between), and the ego cameras are a different headset (HMC_8434xxxx/8435xxxx), so the e3/e4 analogue by camera id does not exist.

same recording, earlier span: attach interior 302.0-312.0 s, then attach roof, attempt to attach bumper, screw chassis 335.3-348.4 s and only an `attempt to attach body` (348.4-354.2 s); the body is never attached, and the roof attach dominates the middle of the span.
